metric: Number of digital objects newly added to the archive; one whole object is the counting unit.
population: Archive EAST, collection ALPHA only. Already existing objects and deleted records are excluded.
window: Use accession time in UTC, starting at 2026-10-01 00:00:00 included and ending at 2026-11-01 00:00:00 excluded.
basis: Deduplicate by object ID, counting each ID exactly once. Assign the period using accession timestamp.
